summary: Teach kids logic, sequencing and problem solving through playful challenges
description:
BUILD, ORGANIZE… AND RUN YOUR FACTORY AT FULL SPEED!
A storm has turned everything upside down! Pango’s world is in ruins… Climb aboard Fox’s factory truck and become the mastermind behind the operation: program the machines, combine actions — cut, turn, paint, glue — and produce the parts needed to rebuild every building.

Challenge after challenge, you program your machine, observe the result, adjust, and improve your code. More than 70 missions await you to understand how steps connect and how each action influences the next.

Pango Factory introduces children to the basics of programming in a simple and playful way: logic, sequences, trial and error, organization… An ideal experience from age 7 to learn how to think like a programmer while having fun.

A PANGO CREATION
For over 15 years, Pango games have supported children in their learning journey with rich, caring, and accessible experiences. Pango Factory continues this mission by introducing the foundations of coding through a smart, progressive, and fully interactive game designed to stimulate logical thinking.

WHY DO PARENTS LOVE PANGO FACTORY?
- Introduces programming logic
- Strengthens problem-solving and sequential thinking
- Encourages trial and error, focus, and independence
- More than 70 progressive challenges
- 4 worlds to explore with increasing difficulty
- No stress, no timer, play at your own pace

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No advertising
• No external links
• Built-in parental controls
• Compliant with children’s data protection standards (COPPA)

PANGO VALUES: LOGIC, CREATIVITY, INDEPENDENCE
At Pango, we create games that spark the desire to learn, understand, and experiment. Our worlds encourage exploration, perseverance, and the pride of success.

Need help? A question? contact@studio-pango.com

More info: www.studio-pango.com

DOWNLOAD PANGO FACTORY and introduce your child to coding through 70 clever challenges: PROGRAM, TEST… AND SAVE THE WORLD OF PANGO!
